description: Defines the SharedBuffer class for inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore synchronization, including constructors, buffer management, and access control methods.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data over process boundaries using shared memory and semaphores, supporting producer and consumer roles.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for consumer role, initializes shared buffer with default size.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for producer role, sets up shared memory and locks semaphore.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests permission to produce data, locking semaphore with wait time.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and unlocks consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests permission to consume data, locking semaphore with wait time.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data has been consumed and unlocks producer semaphore.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns number of bytes written to buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Checks user permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Checks group permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Checks permission mode for the shared buffer.
